article.story: LAFAYETTE, La. -- — Chandler Jackson put up 31 points as Arkansas State beat Louisiana 79-62 on Thursday. Jackson added five rebounds for the Red Wolves (17-11, 8-7 Sun Belt Conference). Jalen Hampton scored 12 points and added 12 rebounds. Jaxon Olvera and Dorian Finister both led the Ragin' Cajuns (9-19, 6-9) in scoring, each finishing with 18 points. De'Vion Lavergne also had 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
